loss: Day-60 raw-score MSE, equal CVE weight
selection: Earliest strict best Day-60 selection RMSE among trained epochs; no refit
architecture: 768 -> Linear(32) -> LayerNorm -> GELU -> Linear(32) -> GELU -> Linear(1) -> sigmoid
primary: AP gain of logit(mean ten-seed description prediction) + logit(past EPSS) versus raw past EPSS
progression: Positive point AP gain and joint evidence-group/seed 95% interval lower bound > 0; exploratory continuation only
ranking_scope: All 7797 isolated-day-policy eligible assessment CVEs; strict observed-future sensitivity required
seed_resampling: One multinomial draw of the ten seed identities shared across all folds in each bootstrap replicate
